# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We as contributors, maintainers, and community members pledge to make participation in **Signo** a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

We specifically pledge to uphold an inclusive, supportive environment for members of the **Deaf and Hard of Hearing (HOH)** communities, recognizing sign language as a primary, vibrant linguistic medium.

---

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment:
- Prioritizing visual accessibility and non-auditory inclusive design.
- Demonstrating empathy and respect toward all community members.
- Accepting constructive feedback gracefully.
- Using welcoming and inclusive language.

Examples of unacceptable behavior:
- The use of sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome sexual attention or advances.
- Trolling, insulting, or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks.
- Public or private harassment.
- Audist or ableist rhetoric or discrimination against signing communities.
- Publishing others' private information without explicit permission.

---

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Community maintainers are responsible for clarifying standards of acceptable behavior and taking appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any instances of unacceptable behavior.

---

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces (GitHub issues, discussions, pull requests) and when an individual is representing the project in public spaces.

---

## Reporting

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported by contacting the project team at `stserentzoulias@outlook.com`. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and confidentially.
